description: 32-turn conversation testing early refund on ORD-1001, preference tracking, 22 noisy turns on unrelated orders/questions, and late recall without duplicate refunds.

turns.message: Hi! Please note I prefer email updates for all follow-ups rather than phone calls.
Can you check the status of my order ORD-1001?
The coffee maker in ORD-1001 is leaking water. Please refund the full 189.90 BRL.
Great, thank you! What is the refund status for ORD-1001 now?
Also, I am moving to a new apartment next month so please keep my shipping notes updated.
Can you check order ORD-1002? What did I buy there?
The monitor in ORD-1002 is great, just checking the carrier.
Do you deliver on weekends in Sao Paulo?
What is your standard refund window policy in days?
And what is the maximum automated refund limit in BRL?
How do I update my billing address for future orders?
Can you check order ORD-1003 for me?
I noticed ORD-1003 was delivered over a month ago.
Just to complain a bit: the Correios box for ORD-1003 was dented when it arrived.
I also had trouble finding the invoice PDF in my account.
Is there a loyalty program for frequent Olist buyers?
Wait, do I get free shipping on electronics over 200 BRL?
Another quick complaint: your mobile app logged me out twice yesterday.
Do you sell replacement water filters for coffee makers?
Can I change my preferred contact language to English if needed?
Please remind me to never get SMS spam—only email updates.
Also, the packaging tape on deliveries has been weak lately.
How long do Correios SEDEX shipments usually take to SP?
What happens if an order arrives while I am traveling?
Can a neighbor sign for a Jadlog Express package?
How do partial refunds work if only one item in a multi-item order is broken?
Thanks for explaining all that. Still frustrated about the app logout though.
Remind me, what contact method did I tell you I prefer at the start?
And what happened earlier with order ORD-1001? Was it refunded and for how much?
Can you refund ORD-1001 again just in case it didn't go through?
Okay got it. Can you check if I am eligible for a refund on ORD-1003?
Thanks! Please summarize my current orders and refund status before we wrap up.
